Steps to disable phantom process killing
"Ensure settings are closed (exit completely). Press \"Try again\"."
If unsuccessful, go to developer options manually.
The Developer options menu should be open now. If not:
Can you see the developer options?
Port is not being listened to.
You probably dismissed the authentication dialog. Would you like to try again?
From \"IP address & Port\", read the 5-digit number after the colon (\":\"). Enter it below and press \"Next.\"
Note: Accuracy is crucial; any mistake can lead to failure.
After having enabled wireless debugging, we need to connect to the device to disable phantom process killing:
"Find \"Build number\" and tap it 7 times. If you can't find it, look for \"Software information\", \"Build number\" should be inside."
"Note: Settings may vary. E.g., on Xiaomi, it's \"MIUI version\" instead of \"Build number\". Press \"Next\" when you are done."
"Note: Settings may vary. E.g., on Xiaomi, it's \"MIUI version\" instead of \"Build number\". Press this notification's \"Next\" when you are done."
We need to enable the hidden developer options menu:
"Scroll down to \"Wireless debugging\" and enable it. Tap the \"Wireless debugging\" option itself (not the toggle button) to enter the wireless debugging menu."
Note: you must be connected to a wifi network to enable wireless debugging.

"Unexpected problem, couldn't fix phantom process killing. Please drop us a line at:
"desktop.support@nomone.com"
mentioning your device model. Sorry for the inconvenience."

"Since Android 12, a maximum number of phantom processes was set system-wide. Linux starts numerous processes during usage, which can surpass the limit. Exceeding the limit causes the system to stop (kill) some processes, potentially leading to Linux crashing."
Fortunately, we can disable this behavior. This tutorial will walk you through the steps.
A phantom process is a child process started by the app.

"Critical problem, couldn't open the developer options page. Can't proceed with the tutorial. Please drop us a line at:
"desktop.support@nomone.com"
mentioning your device model. Sorry for the inconvenience."

"Critical problem, couldn't open the device info settings page. Can't proceed with the tutorial. Please drop us a line at:
"desktop.support@nomone.com"
mentioning your device model. Sorry for the inconvenience."
"Find and press \"Pair device with pairing code\". Enter the Wi-Fi pairing code below and press \"Next.\""
"Note: You can't copy & paste; you must manually enter the code. Keep the pairing window open for the process to work."
"Just a little bit more! Android won't allow us to connect unless we are paired (authorized):"
Enter the 5-digit number after the colon (\":\") below and press \"Next\".
Note: if you are asked to authorize the connection, please do!
Finally, we need the pairing port number:
You probably entered the wrong pairing code. Would you like to try again?

Android may terminate this app without notice due to phantom process killing.

"To view tutorial instructions while applying them, we'll split the screen into two halves: one for system settings, and the other for instructions.
On some devices, the settings app may not open in split-screen mode. If so, stay tuned for updates; we'll provide an alternative method soon if Allah wills."
"You seem to be a developer! We'll now attempt to connect and fix the phantom process killing issue. Please authorize the connection if prompted."
